preconditions.description: The first input line is an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 100) representing the grid size.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) <= 3 for a in stdin_lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Each subsequent input line is an integer a (1 ≤ a ≤ 3) representing Alice's chosen color for the current turn.
The total number of input lines is exactly n² + 1 (1 for n, n² for Alice's moves).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n for i, j in placed_cells)
preconditions.description: All previously placed cells (i, j) are within the grid bounds (1 ≤ i, j ≤ n).
The number of placed cells equals the number of turns completed so far.

preconditions.expression: all(b != a for (a, (b, i, j)) in zip(stdin_lines[1:], moves))
preconditions.description: For each move, the chosen color b is not equal to Alice's chosen color a.

preconditions.expression: all((i, j) not in placed_cells for (b, i, j) in moves)
preconditions.description: Each placed cell (i, j) is empty (not previously occupied).

postconditions.expression: all(not (color_grid[i][j] == color_grid[i'][j'] and abs(i-i') + abs(j-j') == 1) for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, n+1) for i_ in range(1, n+1) for j_ in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: After all n² turns, no two adjacent cells (sharing an edge) have tokens of the same color, ensuring Bob wins.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= b <= 3 and b != a for a, (b, i, j) in zip(stdin_lines[1:], moves))
postconditions.description: For every turn, the chosen color b is valid (1 ≤ b ≤ 3 and b ≠ a).

postconditions.expression: all((i, j) not in placed_cells for (b, i, j) in moves[:-1])
postconditions.description: Each move places a token in an empty cell (no cell is occupied more than once).
Exactly n² moves are made, filling the grid completely.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n for (b, i, j) in moves)
postconditions.description: All placed cells (i, j) are within the grid bounds (1 ≤ i, j ≤ n).

invariants.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n for (i, j) in placed_cells)
invariants.description: At any point, all placed cells (i, j) are within the grid bounds.

invariants.expression: all(not (color_grid[i][j] == color_grid[i'][j'] and abs(i-i') + abs(j-j') == 1) for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, n+1) for i_ in range(1, n+1) for j_ in range(1, n+1) if (i, j) in placed_cells and (i_, j_) in placed_cells)
invariants.description: At any point, no two adjacent placed cells have the same color.
